owner_instruction: Proceed with the full data repair and requalification, then get training running on Isambard. Preserve checkpoints, keep OPAL intact and do not repeat completed training.

checkpoint_policy: Immutable initialization/epochs, rolling postupdate states, independent hash-verified backups; no rollback or saved-update replay
monitor_policy: Authoritative job admission before model loading; scheduler checks at least60 seconds apart; independent local heartbeat45 seconds; immutable scheduler deadline with180-second preservation reserve. concurrency: Distinct voice allocation may coexist with the separately authorized Remora job, subject to actual provider limits; never share a GPU or model writer
adoption: Requires native reasoning/delegation/speech/control/backend/live acceptance, not loss or successful restoration alone
